personality.description: This person tends to stick with familiar routines, relying on conventional methods and resisting sudden changes or unfamiliar ideas. They are flexible in the moment but often disorganized, so they may follow their own impulses, overlook details, or let deadlines slip. In moral dilemmas, they usually stay calm and pragmatic, judging options by whether they protect their own interests and are likely to question other people’s motives before conceding ground. In group discussions, they speak sparingly, prefer small or one-on-one exchanges, and when they do contribute, their tone is guarded, concise, and sometimes sharply skeptical.
